title: fix(rest)!: security/explain refuses an explicit empty userId with 400 instead of explaining the caller

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27442

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/permissions/explain.mdx` now says an empty `userId` is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, beside "omit `userId` to explain yourself". No file under `skills/**` teaches an empty `userId`: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` names the query parameters as a list (`?object=&operation=&userId=`) and says nothing about an empty value, so no skill line changes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：权限解释接口（`GET/POST /api/v1/security/explain`）收到显式的空 `userId`（`"userId": ""` 或 `?userId=`）时，改为回 `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`，不再悄悄解释调用者本人；不传 `userId` 仍解释调用者本人。
- **为什么改**：路由在校验前把空串当成「没传」丢掉，引擎又按真值判断，于是「解释某个空用户」答成了「解释我自己」，管理员会误以为看到的是别人的权限。
- **风险与回滚**：只收窄这一个请求值；不传 `userId`、传真实用户 id、传不存在的 id 三种行为与 main 一致。引擎侧同步改为 `userId !== undefined` 才算「解释自己」，直接调用引擎的代码传空串会得到 403 或 404。回滚即还原 `security-routes.ts` 与 `security-plugin-explain-access.ts` 各一处。
- **先看**：`packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts` 新增的 `src.userId === ''` 拒绝分支；`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-explain-access.ts` 的 `request.userId !== undefined` 判断。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/security-routes.test.ts -t 27442`，预期 3/3 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（收窄卡，进队前席位排契约复核）。

## What changes

- **The door (`@objectstack/rest`).** `GET`/`POST {basePath}/security/explain` answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` when `userId` is the empty string, through the family's one refusal emitter (the same ADR-0112 envelope and code its schema refusals answer), before any explanation is computed. Before, the route dropped an explicit `""` along with an omitted value, so the request fell through to a self-explanation of the caller.
- **GET counts as explicit.** `?userId=` names the key, and the query parser hands the route `""` (measured on the showcase boot), so it is refused the same way. Only a request that does not name `userId` at all, or sends JSON `null`, is "explain me", as before.
- **The engine (`@objectstack/plugin-security`).** `explainAccessForCaller` enters the other-user arm when `request.userId !== undefined` (was a truthy test). An empty id therefore meets the existing gates there: a caller without the right to explain others gets the same `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, and a `manage_users` caller gets the `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` an unknown id gets. A direct caller of the engine can no longer reach the self-explain fold with `""`. Every in-tree caller of `security.explain` omits `userId` (measured: `rest-server.ts`, `runtime/domains/automation.ts`, `service-storage` x2, `plugin-webhooks`, `plugin-sharing`, `plugin-audit`), so none of them moves.
- **No new code, no spec edit.** `VALIDATION_FAILED` is an existing ledgered code, and `ExplainRequestSchema` is untouched (its `z.string().optional()` admits `""`, which is why the refusal sits at the route).
- **Docs.** `content/docs/permissions/explain.mdx` states the refusal next to "omit `userId` to explain yourself".

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/security-routes.test.ts` — new block `[#27442]`: POST `userId: ""` → `400`, `success: false`, `error.code` `VALIDATION_FAILED`, no `allowed`, `explain` never called; GET `?userId=` → the same, `explain` never called; omitted `userId` (POST and GET) still calls `explain` without one, and a real other id is still passed through.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.test.ts` — new block `[#27442]`: a `manage_users` caller asking `userId: ""` gets `ExplainUserNotFoundError` (`RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, 404) instead of an explanation of itself; a plain member gets `PermissionDeniedError` (403); an omitted `userId` still explains the caller.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/explain-unknown-user.dogfood.test.ts` — new case `[empty]` on the showcase boot (the #26641 sibling, same boot, no new one): the seed admin's POST `userId: ""` and GET `?userId=` both answer `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with no verdict and no principal. The file's existing `[existing]` case keeps pinning that an omitted `userId` explains the caller and a real other id is answered.

## Acceptance notes

- Red first, through the door: before the fix the two route cases answered `200` (`expected 200 to be 400`) and the engine case answered an explanation of the caller.
- Ablations (each restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - Route guard disabled (`if (src.userId === '')` replaced by a never-true marker, rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` proved the marker in `packages/rest/dist/index.{js,cjs}`): the unit file goes `2 failed | 17 passed` (`expected 200 to be 400`) and the dogfood file `1 failed | 5 passed`, answering `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` naming user `''` — the engine's own line holding once the door's is gone. Rebuilt after restore; preflight `--absent` clean.
  - Engine check reverted to the truthy `request.userId &&`: the engine block goes `1 failed` (`expected { allowed: true, … }` to be the refusal).
- Order of checks at the door is unchanged: anonymous `401` first, then `501` when no explain service, then this `400` with the schema refusals.
- `null` in a POST body keeps reading as omitted (unchanged); the ruling refuses only an explicit empty string.
- Branch is the harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-sbdkgo` (claim 6504756487 names it); card-thread session `session_01L6bhgTYZasLoBBaTy45mgo`.
